test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option which has the same relation with the third word as the second word with the first word.

Psychiatrist : Mental Health : : Dermatologist : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 
• Psychiatrist : Mental Health → All the mental health disease is cure by Psychiatrist.

Similarly,

 
• Dermatologist : Skin → All the skin related disease is cure and treated by Dermatologist.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Skin"**
